scope: controlled 6-round reduced-key exact algebraic-cancellation falsifier; distinct from raw dependency-union MITM
projection_family: At each split test all 16 single boundary words and all 120 unordered pairwise XOR projections word_i XOR word_j; 136 projections/split, 680 projection-splits total.
forward_exact_independence: Evaluate the exact forward boundary projection on all 256x256 logical half pairs. A projection is low-only iff every row is constant across high; high-only iff every column is constant across low.
backward_exact_independence: For each fresh observed target output, form the candidate-dependent implied final state, invert exactly to the same split, evaluate the identical projection on all 256x256 candidate half pairs, and test low-only/high-only by the same exact constancy rule.
primary_candidate: A fixed split/projection/orientation is a candidate only if forward depends exactly on one half and backward depends exactly on the opposite half on all four fresh targets.
match_rule: For a candidate, construct 256 forward half values and 256 backward half values from the exact independent functions and count equality matches. The true half-pair is checked only after the match set is formed.
selection_if_multiple: minimum worst-case match count across the four frozen targets, then smaller split, then projection arity (single before pair), then lexical word tuple, then low-forward orientation before high-forward
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze untouched b-widths/targets and perform explicit half-table construction, matching, collisions, exact verification and TOTAL exponent scaling. No alpha<1 claim from this b16 structural stage alone.
kill_rule: If no fixed projection/orientation is exact half-separated on all four fresh targets, or every such candidate exceeds 512 matches on any target, close single/pair boundary-XOR cancellation MITM immediately.
forbidden: No approximate independence, target-specific projection choice, projection of 3+ words, modular replacement, alternate layout, or second target set inside this milestone.
